notes.title: Skyward Extraction is moving to 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011568/7661d395e7597687443decb736bde8006c1bcef6.png[/img]


[h1]Skyward Extraction is officially Released! [/h1]

Greetings, Skyfarers! 

When we started Skyward extraction, we were just a couple of friends that really wanted to make something fun. We poured our heart and souls into the project and got into early access to bring you all along the journey with us.  We've seen some incredible clips, read some awesome stories, and laughed at some hilarious screenshots. 

But the state of the games industry is in an interesting place. As this was a passion project from an incredibly small team, the development slowed quite a bit when *real jobs* had to take over. 

Over the last several months the team has been using their free time to make sure we aren't leaving you high and dry and to put out a game we would want to play. 

With this update, we feel like we have a solid fun gameplay loop that you and your friends can enjoy for many hours. 

We don't want to spoil any of the surprise so we're going to keep the details light!  
We've added some things, adjusted others and fixed a multitude of bugs, and we hope you enjoy the new challenge!

We'll be gauging reactions and paying attention to feedback still, to make sure we keep all those bugs squashed. As feedback comes in we will figure out what direction to take the game and how it will grow.  

We want to thank all of you who've been with us from the early access and helped make this game what it is. We hope you have a great time and can't wait to see you all Beyond the Stormwall. 

-Naughty Clogs.

notes.title: COMMUNICATION IS IMPORTANT!
notes.content:
[h1]Talk To Me ![/h1]

Greetings, Storm Treaders!  

When Skyward Extraction first launched, the proximity voice chat was a really important feature for us, and in internal testing, things seemed to be working the way we intended. 
But as with all things, once it got out into the wild and hundreds of players were using it, the cracks started to show. 

This update has been a huge priority for us. We want you to be able to immerse yourself in the world of relencost, and that's hard to do when you've got to use a 3rd Party application just to communicate with your friends. 

WIth this update, we've completely ripped out and implemented a brand new voice chat solution. 
This should fix all voice disconnection issues, stuttering, and poor sound quality as well as integrating into the current sound and audio system much more efficiently. 

There are still more things we are planning, like Separate volume control per player, muting loud folks, and rebinding the push to talk hotkey, but we wanted to get a working voice chat into the game as a priority that we can then update and polish as we continue through early access. 

With this change, you may need to manually set your Input device in the settings menu before others will be able to hear you, but for the most part it should work right out of the box. 

We've also been working on a bunch of minor bugfixes and trying to clear out as many crashes as we can. 

In this update, you'll also find some small QoL changes and a bit of visual polish. 

Once again, the team here at Naughty Clogs wants to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for joining us in this adventure. We appreciate each and every one of you as we continue growing the world. }

Until Next time, we'll see YOU beyond the stormwall! 

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[b]Brand new voice chat implementation.[/b]

[b]Drone Message System for broadcasting your voice to the drone operator.[/b]


[h2]Changed[/h2]
[b]Fuel is now used when leaving a location, but trying to fly to a new location with 0 fuel will result in your run failing.[/b]

[b]Enemies should no longer camp out in the dungeon entrance. We've made other locations much more appealing. [/b]

[b]Lantern No Longer interacts with Fog, so it should be a little more clear[/b]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed Sound volume settings.

Added missing sounds for Out of Fuel, and Drone becoming available.

Fixed Several rare crashes.

Fixed Goblin getting stuck in one spot shooting darts at the wall.

notes.title: Polish and fixes, with a new vibe
notes.content:
Hello! Happy spooky season, Storm Treaders!

This is a fairly small, but hopefully impactful update just in time for Halloween. 

Our focus has been crashes and bug fixes but we also packed in some new modules into the current dungeons as well as adjusting the way that dungeon generation works. This should come through with much more interesting interiors. 

We've also adjusted the prices for all items to make a little more sense. (i'm looking at you large obnoxious 2 handed items worth 20g !) 

Finally we've revamped the lighting system across the game, to bring the vibes a little closer to what we were trying to do. 

Up next on the chopping block is our voice chat system. We've never truly been happy with the implementation and we've heard and seen quite a few issues. We're in the process of completely ripping it out and setting up an entirely new solution that we're hoping fixes all the issues we've seen with it. 
Stay tuned, we're hoping to have that out to you in a few weeks! 


Thank you all again for hanging out beyond the stormwall and for the awesome feedback you've been leaving.

notes.title: 0.3.7 Hotfix
notes.content:
Quick Fix - Grapple automatically closing on use. 
Fixed - Potential workaround for Out Of Video Memory Crash on machines with older graphics cards ( Please update your drivers if you haven't <3 )

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.6 - Mommy no!
notes.content:
Greetings, Stormtreaders! 

We've got a light one here with some bug fixes, clarity changes, and adjustments to the way that the Mother works. 

Fixed - Backpacks expending all of their charges at once
Fixed - Dead player names not showing up on the spectator UI
Fixed - Players could spawn ghost objects while using the drone controller. They have been Exorcised.
Fixed - Mother now attempts to find alternate paths to the player but will give up after a time if unable.
Fixed - Rare crash when picking up items has been fixed
Fixed - Players no longer continue running when activating the drone controller.
Fixed - Goblin no longer steals multiple items from incapacitated players. He was being very greedy.
Fixed - Dying while incapacitated would prevent you from controlling your spectator. Now you may observe.
Fixed - Fuel was uncapped, it should now stay inside of the fuel container.

Added - Slot indicators for perks, to make it more clear that 4 perks can be equipped at once

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011568/7661d395e7597687443decb736bde8006c1bcef6.png[/img]

First of all, we at Naughty Clogs want to thank each and every one of you who've joined us Beyond the Stormwall. It's been incredible to see you all having such a good time in our world and we can't wait to bring you more. We've been watching your streams, reading your feedback, and taking [i][b]LOTS [/b][/i]of notes. 

There's a lot of stuff on our radar now and we're working through that list as quickly as possible. As a really tiny team, some of these will take a bit of time.   Right now we're making sure we focus on some of the biggest issues to guarantee you all can continue to have a good time. 

We've noticed a few people struggling with a GPU crash that we're trying to drill down into.

[h1]If you are getting an Out of Video Memory crash:[/h1]
We're trying to see if there's anything we can do on our end, but if you're running into this seemingly random crash, please make sure that your video card drivers are up to date.  We know some things have changed in the way rendering is optimized in the newer versions of Unreal Engine and these newer driver updates are a potential quick fix. 


[h2] The heartiest of Thank Yous[/h2]
Once again, from the bottom of our hearts: Thank you so much for joining us on this adventure. It's been a wild ride getting Skyward Extraction out the door, but we're having an incredible time and your love and feedback has been pivotal in that process. 

Keep those stories and videos coming, we really do watch every single one of them. 



[h3] Changelog:[/h3]
[b]Hotfix [/b] - Fixed rare crash when trying to interact with an object that someone else is also trying to interact with. 

[b]Hotfix [/b]- The Drone now respects your controller settings, so it shouldn't be spinning around at mach 5 anymore.  Even you folks that love inverted mouse look, we've got you covered too.

[b]Hotfix [/b]-  Fixed The *E to Control* dialogue should no longer show up across the map when you're flying the drone.

[b]Hotfix [/b]- Fixed issue where backpacks would disappear when using the drone controller.

notes.title: Minor Hotfix 6/18/24
notes.content:
We've implemented a new voice chat system that should be more stable for everyone. 
This allows us to implement a new push to talk feature with V being the default push to talk hotkey. 
Currently we don't have the ability to rebind keys at the moment, but it's definitely on the roadmap. 

We've also addressed a few other issues that have popped up from the feedback you've given us so far. 



Fixes:
*Melvin no longer steals the items You've purchased. He will now place them on the ground in front of the counter.

*Players should no longer fall through the ship when interacting with the map while it is moving.

*The Drone Control Terminal now correctly shows when the drone pack is deployed correctly, the light should turn green on the ship when the drone is available to control. 

*Standing on the drone backpack will no longer prevent the drone from spawning ( leading to the drone user getting completely ruined)
